description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Zuora Account records via the generic Object CRUD API. Zuora has no upsert-by-key endpoint and no filter-by-field GET -- this component queries by lookup_field first via ZOQL (POST /v1/action/query) to discover an existing Account Id, then issues PUT /v1/object/account/{id} (update) or POST /v1/object/account (create). Two API calls per row. Create requires Name, Currency, BillCycleDay, and Status in fields_map -- no defaults are supplied.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Zuora Account record (upserted via lookup_field, typically AccountNumber).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Zuora.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

lookup_field.label: Lookup Field
lookup_field.description: Zuora Account field used to find an existing record via a ZOQL where clause. MUST be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Zuora Account field name. Must include Name, Currency, BillCycleDay, and Status for create to succeed.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). No upsert-by-key endpoint -- each row costs 1 ZOQL query + 1 write.

name: Zuora Account Upsert
